_doc: THE LAST LIGHT v2 night script. t = seconds from 02:17. bearing in degrees (0 = north, clockwise). aim: 'reef' (blind course onto the nearest reef), or a number = heading offset in degrees from straight at the light. Seeded jitter: +-3 s, +-4 deg.

ships.name: Kittiwake
ships.call: North Point Light, this is fishing vessel Kittiwake. We're lost in the murk, visibility near nothing. Requesting a course in, over.

ships.name: Gannet
ships.call: North Point, North Point, schooner Gannet. We've lost the shore lights. Can you guide us in? Over.

ships.name: Corrie May
ships.call: Light station, this is Corrie May, fishing, coming in from the east. The sea's building fast. Need a bearing, over.

ships.name: Lowestoft Star
ships.call: North Point Light, Lowestoft Star. Running before the wind, can't see a thing. Advise, over.

ships.name: Bonnie Jean
ships.call: North Point, Bonnie Jean here, two souls aboard. We're taking water and need the quickest way in, over.

ships.name: Meridian
ships.call: Mayday relay, North Point Light, this is cargo vessel Meridian. Steering gear's sluggish and we're drifting toward the eastern rocks. Request immediate assistance, over.

logbook.title: 02:17 — Watch begins
logbook.text:
Storm warning from the coastguard. Battery bank at about 60%. The light is on AUTO, lamp at NORMAL.

Ships will call on the radio (desk, north wall). Use CONFIRM POSITION to find them on the radar, then TURN PORT / TURN STARBOARD (30° each) to line them up with a channel on the chart: West Gut 314°, North Sound 000°, East Gut 046°.

A ship that can see our light and is lined up inbound on a channel will pilot itself home.

logbook.title: Power
logbook.text:
The battery won't last the night. Start the generator (south-west cage): open the FUEL VALVE, then hold START until it catches. Switch CHARGE on at the charger (west wall).

Watch the generator TEMP: switch CHARGE off before it reaches the red, or it will shut itself down to cool. Close the fuel valve to stop the engine and save diesel.

logbook.title: Rotation motor
logbook.text:
Salt gets into the gear race in heavy weather. If the MOTOR LOAD needle swings into the red and the amber lamp lights, the motor has jammed: turn MODE to OFF, then back to AUTO. Left jammed, it will trip the MAIN breaker.

In an emergency use MANUAL and turn the HANDWHEEL: a focused beam reaches ships far out in the fog.

logbook.title: Main breaker
logbook.text: Lamp on HIGH with the radar, the room lights and a transmission can overload the main circuit. If everything goes dark, reset MAIN at the distribution cabinet (west wall). Switch off the room lights or radar to save power.
